question: Why does kv_attn_n8_int4 have more flip-flops than kv_attn_n8 even though its cache has half the bits?
expect: the int8 baseline cache was already pruned by Yosys (constant ROM bits and merged K3/V3); the int4 clamp logic hides constants, so 96 vs 72 cache flops (222 vs 200)

question: What limits the setup slack of soc_kv_attn_n8?
expect: the Caravel SDC input delay of 12.5 ns on wb_rst_i, which fans out to all 570 flip-flops

question: What fixed the GRT-0116 global routing congestion for tiny_ai_core in the wrapper?
expect: a simpler macro with 109 pins (instead of 361) on the S edge in the order of the wrapper's Wishbone pads

question: Why is the slew repair margin 20 percent and not 70 percent for the macro build?
expect: 70 percent ran out of memory chasing input nets already above the slew limit

question: What caused the 70 LVS errors in the user_project_wrapper?
expect: 40 antenna diodes added by the router that were not connected to power (unpowered)

question: Why did the ChipFoundry precheck go from 12 of 14 to 14 of 14 checks passing?
expect: user_defines.v: GPIO 5..37 set to GPIO_MODE_MGMT_STD_INPUT_NOPULL instead of the template's GPIO_MODE_INVALID (gpio_defines and oeb checks)

question: Which number format is the cost versus accuracy knee in the precision study?
expect: ternary or int4: accuracy is flat from tern upward while fp16 costs 4.8x tern

question: On the SoC, how many CPU cycles does a one-token prefill and a decode cost?
expect: one-token prefill 328 cycles round trip; decode 670 cycles per token (about 2x)

question: Why was soc_image_text_match re-run on 2026-10-06?
expect: shared/rtl/kv_attn_core.v was added next to the adapter and find_reusable_run.py watches the whole directory; metrics identical

question: Why did simplifying the tiny_ai_core pins roughly halve its standard cell count?
expect: the 400 um build with 609 I/O had 3521 std cells (2115 tap cells, 468 repair buffers); the 250 um 109-pin build has 1809 (765 taps)

question: What did the first packaged chips measure for power consumption on the bench, in milliwatts?
Which customer has ordered the kv_attn_n8 chip and at what unit price?
Why does the ring-buffer engine kv_attn_n8_ring lose accuracy on 48-token episodes?
expect: the 5-bit position counter pos saturates at 31, later entries tie on recency and the lowest physical slot wins, which after a wrap is not the newest (accuracy 100.00 to 89.12 percent vs the window oracle)

question: Why is the binary format the only one in the precision study that loses accuracy?
expect: a sign-only weight cannot say a pixel hardly matters, so corner and centre pixels vote with full strength, and a binarised pixel cannot express brightness 7 versus 9

question: Why could the float formats not be fixed by pipelining the accumulate step?
expect: the accumulator feeds back into the next add, so the add-and-normalise chain sits in the accumulate loop and cannot be pipelined without slowing the loop; only the multiply can be split off

question: Why does kv_attn_n16 have only 144 cache flip-flops when its cache is nominally 1024 bits?
expect: the weights are fixed constants so most stored fields carry little information; 7 + 2 = 9 flip-flops per slot instead of 64

question: Why is bf16 smaller than fp16 although both store 16 bits?
expect: bf16 has a shorter mantissa: its multiplier is 8 x 4 instead of 11 x 4, so it is 14.6 percent smaller (10170 vs 11913 um^2)
